method: Same Node/npm/Vite installation, root public VITE settings copied into isolated reconstructions; HEAD archive and Gemini preimages. All-emitted bytes are not first-load transfer. No invented thresholds or Lighthouse/INP score.

limits: Local intercepted APIs and blocked external resources
13 samples, cold/warm cache and 4x CPU; no field RUM or matched historical latency
Input-to-next-frame proxy is not INP; no thresholds declared or passed
No browser heap/leak or real image-provider measurement
Reconstructed bundle hashes can differ with module IDs/path/environment while byte counts remain diagnostic.
No matched baseline browser latency sample, heap proof, RUM/p75/field INP or physical device budget certificate.
Warm mode permits cache; equal measured transfer sizes do not establish cache hits. Earlier incomplete-dist captures and performance are pre-final diagnostics, not final visual proof.
